value.message: Pending jobs are scheduled jobs that either have a "next action" value that is in the past or that has been queued to a specific scheduled worker thread. Under normal conditions, these jobs should be executed imminently.

This score shows the number of jobs that the scheduler is currently processing. If these jobs are short-lived, this score may appear low, while a large number of jobs and/or long-lived jobs will generally drive this score higher.
This graph shows the top 5 job classifications by processing time (ms) from the latest 15-minute window collected for the entire instance. Note that these number may be from 15-30 minutes ago.
